training_data.observation_unit: volunteer shift, service queue interval or program-finance period at the planning timestamp
training_data.input_data: signups, attendance, cancellations, calendar, role and site context, service intake and completion events, capacity, commitments and payments available before planning
training_data.target_or_reward: later shift coverage or no-show, service demand and backlog, or period cash requirement; no reliable cross-organization label is assumed
training_data.label_source: attendance and service completion records, reviewed queue outcomes, and reconciled finance records
training_data.prediction_time: before reminders, replacement assignment, capacity adjustment, spending decision or final period reconciliation
training_data.expected_volume: unknown and likely limited for small organizations; must be measured by program and time granularity
training_data.class_balance: unknown; severe shortages, spikes and interruptions are likely uncommon
training_data.historical_coverage: unknown; depends on consistent check-in, intake, capacity and finance event recording across program changes
training_data.train_validation_split: time-based split with program, site or campaign holdouts where volume permits
training_data.leakage_risks: final attendance, replacement assignment, completed service, revised capacity, corrected expense category and reconciled payment recorded after the planning point
training_data.representativeness_risks: campaigns, emergencies, grant changes, holidays, site openings, volunteer turnover and policy changes alter the sequence-generating process
training_data.feedback_loop: coordinator overrides, actual attendance, unmet demand, backlog recovery and finance reconciliation support later evaluation
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: beneficiary records and volunteer profiles require minimization, purpose limitation, access control and avoidance of sensitive-trait inference
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: self-service scheduling, reminders, waitlists, moving averages, seasonal rules, queue thresholds, scenario planning and human review

portfolio_comparison.reason: volunteer coordination is already served by mature scheduling, reminder, attendance and analytics products; demand and cash-flow candidates reduce to ordinary forecasting, scenario planning or existing capacity patterns without a distinct nonprofit decision-and-outcome spine
